text: Upgrade cozo/git2 deps to clear audit advisories: RUSTSEC-2026-0041 lz4_flex via cozo chain, RUSTSEC-2026-0008 git2 0.19 unsound Buf deref

[SPIKE] Research and implement guardrails to prevent direct-to-main pushes by agents. Incident: commits cbbfb81 and 3fd285a were pushed directly to main bypassing branch protection after a PR merge. Research scope: (1) git pre-push hooks that block pushes to main locally, (2) GitHub branch protection hardening (require PR, disable admin bypass for agents), (3) agent-level instruction/checklist enforcement in copilot-instructions.md, (4) CI workflow to detect and alert on direct main commits. Deliverable: a recommendation with the lowest-friction approach that works for both human and agent contributors, plus implementation.

PDF document ingestion: add ability to parse and chunk PDF files of any size into the pipeline. Requires: PDF text extraction crate (evaluate pdf-extract, lopdf, pdfium), page/section-aware chunking strategy, handling of tables/images/figures (text extraction vs OCR), large-file streaming to avoid memory blowout, integration as a new parser backend alongside Markdown. Needs a spike to evaluate crate choices, extraction quality, and chunking strategy for structured documents.
Fix stale doc comment in src/chunk/mod.rs:5 — still references "LanceDB vectors to Kùzu graph nodes" but should reference CozoDB unified store

Persist embeddings in CozoDB HNSW index and implement semantic vector search (search_similar). Currently vectors are computed during sync but discarded. This is the primary value-add — enabling similarity-based documentation discovery beyond keyword matching. Planned internally as 009-F.

Expand MCP tool surface: add list_sources (enumerate indexed sources), get_chunk_by_id (retrieve chunk by SHA-256 ID), get_document (all chunks for a path), search_semantic (vector search, depends on HNSW), get_status (DB stats/health). Currently only search_local_docs and traverse_doc_links exist.

Wire incremental sync (sync_source) into the CLI sync command. The sync module exists and is tested (git diff + mtime diff + surgical re-ingestion) but cmd_sync uses the full pipeline::run instead. Add --full flag for existing behavior, make incremental the default.

Web crawler acquisition source: add type: url source to sources.yaml for crawling live documentation sites (e.g. learn.microsoft.com/azure/cosmos-db/). Requires: HTTP client (reqwest), HTML-to-Markdown converter, recursive link follower with configurable depth/domain limits, rate limiting, robots.txt compliance, deduplication. This is a new acquisition backend alongside git and local — follows the same pipeline interface (returns list of Markdown files for parse stage). Needs a spike first to evaluate crate choices and crawl strategy.

Word document (.docx) ingestion: add ability to parse and chunk Word documents of any size into the pipeline. Requires: OOXML parser crate (evaluate docx-rs, office-crypto, or zip + xml manual parsing), paragraph/heading-aware chunking, table extraction, embedded image handling, large-file streaming, integration as a new parser backend alongside Markdown and PDF. Needs a spike to evaluate crate choices, extraction fidelity, and chunking strategy for Word's nested structure.

E2E smoke test: configure sources.yaml with azure-cosmos-db-docs repo, run graphtor-docs sync, verify chunks loaded with graphtor-docs status, start MCP server with graphtor-docs serve, test search_local_docs and traverse_doc_links against real Cosmos DB documentation content.

Agent harness learning: Stage agent MUST NOT call backlogit_ship_shipment, backlogit_claim_shipment, backlogit_archive_item, or backlogit_delete_item. Stage only assembles shipments and gates readiness (verifies tasks are decomposed, plans reviewed, tests defined). Ship agent owns: claiming the shipment, feature branch creation, build loop, PR lifecycle, CI validation, review handling, operator-approved merge, and THEN backlogit_ship_shipment. Stage's terminal action is confirming readiness and reporting to the operator for Ship orchestration.

Mature the documentation source registry (sources.yaml) to support mixed-format ingestion per source: each Git, URL, or local source entry should declare which document types it contains (PDF, DOCX, Markdown) so the pipeline dispatches the correct parser per file. Add schema validation, default format lists, and per-source format override configuration. This enables a single Git repo source to ingest its Markdown, PDF, and DOCX files in one pass.

Fully test PDF, DOCX, and Git repo documentation ingestion: create comprehensive integration tests covering each acquisition source type end-to-end (acquire → parse → chunk → embed → load). Validate correct handling of edge cases (large files, malformed input, empty documents, nested structures) for each format. Ensure deterministic chunk IDs and idempotent re-ingestion across all three source types.
